description: This source file defines the MultiSelectedActionModeCallback class, which manages context actions (such as delete, move, share, categorize) for multiple selected notes in an Android note-taking app. It implements the ActionMode.Callback interface to handle user interactions during multi-selection mode within the note list.

classes.name: MultiSelectedActionModeCallback
classes.description: A callback handler for multi-selection action mode that provides actions like delete, move, share, and categorize notes.

methods.name: MultiSelectedActionModeCallback
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and theme attributes for the callback.

methods.name: onCreateActionMode
methods.description: Inflates the contextual menu and applies theming to icons when multi-selection mode starts.

methods.name: onPrepareActionMode
methods.description: Prepares the action mode; returns false indicating no updates needed.

methods.name: onActionItemClicked
methods.description: Handles menu item actions: delete, move, share, categorize selected notes, with implementations for each.

methods.name: onDestroyActionMode
methods.description: Cleans up the selection and finishes the action mode.
